purpose: Teach: 野蛮/因縁/壮絶/和声/手話/威嚇/平常/直視

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、植民地化と「野蛮」言説の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote about the history of colonialism and the discourse around 'savagery,' didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Even pace. Genuine curiosity — not testing, inviting him to clarify. Light on the statement, genuine interest in the answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治家同士の因縁の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote about the history of political rivalries between leaders.
lines.style: Quiet correction, no defensiveness. Steady pace. A small pause before the pivot, like he's used to the misalignment. Respectful but truthful.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の壮絶な体験記を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored the harrowing firsthand accounts from wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower, more reflective. Acknowledging the weight of the subject. Careful respect in the tone. A slight lean forward — genuine wonder at his choice of topic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、楽曲の和声分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I was actually analyzing harmonic structures in musical composition.
lines.style: Patient, gentle correction. No impatience, just matter-of-fact. The second time explaining a mismatch. Slight weariness underneath but not showing it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 聴覚障害者の手話教育を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about sign language education for deaf learners, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but testing the pattern now. A slight anticipatory energy — she's starting to notice something. Still warm, but with an undercurrent of curiosity about what's happening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、動物の威嚇行動の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched animal threat displays and defensive behavior.
lines.style: Even quieter this time. The corrections are stacking. His voice carries a faint undertone of fatigue, but still earnest. No blame in it, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、平常時と災害時の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you compared conditions during peacetime versus disaster scenarios, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, slower still. A dawning realization in her voice — she's sensing a pattern of mismatch. Curious now in a different way. Less statement, more genuine question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、歴史の暗部を直視する研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined historical blind spots, confronting the darker parts of history directly.
lines.style: Tired but committed. Closing the exchange with quiet dignity. A gentle finality — he's answered clearly, completely, without apology. Softer trailing off.
